rows.title: CT child tax rebate claimed by more than 70% of eligible households
rows.standfirst: Of the $125 million that CT legislators set aside for the child tax credit, about $92.5 million has been claimed.

rows.title: Report: CT’s pension debt remains high despite residents’ personal wealth
rows.standfirst: A recent Pew report provided a sobering reminder of just how far Connecticut still has to go to overcome decades of fiscal irresponsibility.

rows.title: CT essential private sector workers can now apply for pandemic bonuses
rows.standfirst: Essential CT private-sector employees who staffed vital services during the pandemic can now apply for up to a $1,000 bonus from the state.

rows.title: Larry McHugh to replace embattled CT Port Authority official
rows.standfirst: House Speaker Matt Ritter on Saturday named Larry McHugh, the former chair of the UConn Board of Trustees, to the CT Port Authority board.

rows.title: High demand for CT pandemic bonus program crashed website
rows.standfirst: The number of applications for pandemic bonuses for CT private-sector workers in the first days of the program crashed the program’s website.

rows.title: CT essential worker bonuses could be reduced as demand grows
rows.standfirst: Pandemic bonuses for CT private-sector essential workers will likely be reduced as surging demand tests the program’s budget.

rows.title: CT’s second ‘Sales Tax-Free Week’ of 2022 begins Sunday
rows.standfirst: Connecticut residents can buy most clothing and shoes under $100 without paying sales tax for one week, for the second time in 2022.

rows.title: Are CT tax cuts and COVID relief enough? Debate goes on
rows.standfirst: CT Democrats and GOP are battling over the effectiveness of CT tax cuts and COVID relief as some programs struggle to get money to families.

rows.title: Federal probe covers all aspects of CT Port Authority operations
rows.standfirst: In a March subpoena, the U.S. Department of Justice requested all records and correspondence covering all authority business since 2016.

rows.title: CT to send $7M in back-to-school grants to low-income families
rows.standfirst: CT will pay for the grants, which will support about 27,000 children — or $257.87 per child — with federal pandemic aid.

rows.title: CT essential worker bonuses should be fully funded, Scanlon says
rows.standfirst: CT Democrat comptroller candidate Sean Scanlon says $1,000 grants for essential private-sector workers shouldn’t be reduced.

rows.title: I was a CT essential worker. What COVID-19 relief is available to me?
rows.standfirst: Connecticut has launched the Premium Pay Program and COVID-19 Relief Fund for essential workers during the pandemic. Here are the details.

rows.title: CT businesses spared from unemployment tax hikes, for now
rows.standfirst: CT businesses will be spared from unemployment tax hikes for now, but big challenges loom in coming years if debts aren’t paid.

rows.title: Stefanowski pledges to remove hundreds of ‘nuisance taxes’
rows.standfirst: Bob Stefanowski said he won’t wait for the legislature to suspend what he calls “nuisance taxes” and will instead cancel them himself.
